annotation.bound_parties_text: Each High Contracting Party (states party to the Protocol) is bound to comply with the Protocol's obligations on autonomous weapon systems.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Each High Contracting Party shall institute measures to ensure that meaningful human control is retained in the entire life cycle of any weapon system incorporating autonomy
annotation.robot_provision_quote: This Protocol shall apply to all emerging technologies in the area of autonomous weapon systems.
